objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Make the challenge page run JavaScript that shows the string XSS; the page then gives you the flag (FLAG{...}).
hints: Find where your value lands in the returned HTML and which characters or words the filter removes.
The server loads your page in a headless browser and only reveals the flag when the dialog shows the expected string.
